summary: The page handles error occurrences, displaying error messages based on locale settings and configuration. It utilizes ASP.NET to structure its layout and define server-side logic.
purpose: To display error messages in a web application, tailored according to user locale and specific error conditions.

fields.name: HeaderEN
fields.description: Control to display the English header.

fields.name: HeaderFR
fields.description: Control to display the French header.

workflows.name: Page Load Workflow
steps: Check if the locale is set to 'en-US' or not set at all.
Based on the locale, display the corresponding header (English or French).
Fetch the error email address from configuration settings.
Determine the subject from the database configuration.
Check if there is a HttpRequestValidationException query parameter set to '1'.
Display the appropriate error message formatted with the email and subject.

business_rules: Email address for error messages is obtained from web.config settings.
Specific error messages are shown based on the HttpRequestValidationException query parameter.
validations: Locale query parameter is validated and used to set the current culture.
conditions: If the locale is 'en-US' or not set, the default locale is used.
If HttpRequestValidationException equals '1', a specific error message is displayed.
system_behavior: Switches between English and French headers based on locale.
Displays specific error messages based on query parameters and configuration.
dependencies: Locale and error email configurations are dependent on web.config settings.
